select am.alliance_id as alliance_id, am.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) as merchant_name, am.share_stock_enabled as share_stock_enabled, am.accept_order_limit as accept_order_limit, am.current_accept_order_count as current_accept_order_count, am.member_status as member_status, am.join_time as join_time, am.exit_time as exit_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_alliance_member am inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.member_id = am.member_id and m.tenant_id = am.tenant_id and m.is_delete = 0 where am.alliance_id = #{allianceId} and am.member_status in (1, 2, 3) and am.is_delete = case when am.member_status = 1 then 0 else 1 end order by am.member_id
